"6 1/2"" X 8 1/2""; GLASS NEGATIVES.
Yosemite Museum Collection 10243. Shows California artist Chris Jorgensen in his Yosemite studio in front of the fireplace--easel up in front of the chair he is sitting in--mantel of fireplace decorated with the figures of men and various size teakettles and mugs.
